# Proxy d3d11.dll. Installed into the game folder as d3d11.dll by the app.
# The same layer built as tessera_dxgi is the dxgi.dll proxy for D3D12 games,
# and as tessera_vulkan the vulkan-1.dll proxy for Vulkan games.
# Export stubs are generated by tools/gen_exports.sh from <name>_exports.txt.
set(d3d11_exports exports_d3d11.asm exports_d3d11.def)
set(dxgi_exports exports_dxgi.asm exports_dxgi.def)
set(vulkan_exports exports_vulkan.asm exports_vulkan.def)
if(CMAKE_SIZEOF_VOID_P EQUAL 4)
  set(d3d11_exports exports_d3d11_x86.asm exports_d3d11_x86.def)
  set(dxgi_exports exports_dxgi_x86.asm exports_dxgi_x86.def)
  set(vulkan_exports exports_vulkan_x86.asm exports_vulkan_x86.def)
  set_source_files_properties(exports_d3d11_x86.asm exports_dxgi_x86.asm exports_vulkan_x86.asm
                              PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS /safeseh)
endif()

set(layer_sources
  dllmain.cpp
  proxy.cpp
  hooks.cpp
  vtable.cpp
  session.cpp
  stream_io.cpp
  texture_quality.cpp
  log.cpp
  config.cpp
  dedup.cpp
  module.cpp
  process.cpp
  pacing.cpp
  limiter.cpp
  prediction.cpp
  memory.cpp
  mip_feedback.cpp
  nvapi.cpp
  flip.cpp
  shaders.cpp
  workset.cpp
  residency.cpp
  rtpool.cpp
  uecvars.cpp)

add_library(tessera_d3d11 SHARED ${layer_sources} ${d3d11_exports})
add_library(tessera_dxgi SHARED ${layer_sources} ${dxgi_exports})
target_compile_definitions(tessera_dxgi PRIVATE TESSERA_PROXY_DXGI)
# vulkan-1.dll proxy: frame limiter for Vulkan games (no Vulkan SDK needed).
add_library(tessera_vulkan SHARED ${layer_sources} vk_present.cpp ${vulkan_exports})
target_compile_definitions(tessera_vulkan PRIVATE TESSERA_PROXY_VULKAN)

foreach(layer tessera_d3d11 tessera_dxgi tessera_vulkan)
  target_include_directories(${layer} PRIVATE ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/include ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
  # No C++ exceptions, no RTTI in the layer. Never link d3d11.lib or dxgi.lib: we are those DLLs.
  target_compile_definitions(${layer} PRIVATE _HAS_EXCEPTIONS=0)
  target_compile_options(${layer} PRIVATE $<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:CXX>:/EHs-c- /GR- /Zi>)
  target_link_options(${layer} PRIVATE /DEBUG /OPT:REF /OPT:ICF)
  # winmm: timeBeginPeriod (P5). Only system libraries.
  target_link_libraries(${layer} PRIVATE winmm)
endforeach()
